title: Universal Life Insurance Tax Reporting Guide: Surrender Cost Basis for Converted and Exchanged Premiums
content:
The surrender cost basis of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy, against which the taxable amount of a full surrender is measured, follows how the premiums came in. The premium entries in the policy's activity history show how each premium was paid: in cash, as a conversion credit, or by exchange.

## Premiums that count

| Situation on the records | Premiums that count |
|---|---|
| The policy records a converted Ashgrove term policy (Term Life Insurance) shown as converted, and its activity history holds a conversion credit | The gross premiums less the conversion credits |
| No converted term policy is recorded, the activity history holds a premium paid by exchange, and the owner holds an Ashgrove whole life policy (Whole Life Insurance) shown as surrendered | The gross premiums less the exchanged amounts, plus that whole life policy's cost basis |
| Otherwise | Every gross premium |

From the premiums that count, the premiums refunded and the non-taxable part of earlier withdrawals are taken off. The non-taxable part of a withdrawal is its amount less its withdrawal fee less its taxable part, as shown on each partial withdrawal entry.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Records | Premiums that count | Less refunds and non-taxable withdrawals | Surrender cost basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Converted term policy shown as converted; gross premiums $90000.00 including a $15000.00 conversion credit | $75000.00 | $0.00 | $75000.00 |
| No converted term policy; gross premiums $200000.00 including $120000.00 paid by exchange; owner's whole life policy shown as surrendered with a cost basis of $95000.00 | $175000.00 | refunds $2000.00 | $173000.00 |
| No conversion credit and no exchange; gross premiums $60000.00 | $60000.00 | one withdrawal of $5025.00 with a $25.00 fee and $1000.00 taxable, non-taxable part $4000.00 | $56000.00 |

Where premiums were paid by exchange but the owner holds no whole life policy shown as surrendered, every gross premium counts.
